hypotheses.H1: Adding rank variance reduces out-of-rank-pair CV RMSE at least 10% under both class and combo weighting
hypotheses.H2: Suited-minus-offsuit equity gain is constant across 78 rank pairs
hypotheses.H3: Lower mean final rank always means higher random-opponent equity

validation: leave one rank pair out: suited and offsuit are held out together; pairs are separate groups
monte_carlo: existing 1M samples per class are estimated targets; no simultaneous confidence claim for model errors

confirmation.selection: largest estimated equity inversion after discovery, then freeze pair before new sampling
confirmation.criterion: one-sided direction also excludes zero in two-sided 95% normal difference interval

interpretation: exploratory analysis of 169 fixed classes; cross-validation is not proof of generality to other streets or ranges
